name: PILLAR Corporation
capabilities: Sealing solutions including mechanical seals and gaskets
india_angle: PILLAR Corporation is committed to supporting the growth of the semiconductor ecosystem in India with fluid-control, sealing, and engineering solutions.
summary: PILLAR Corporation specializes in fluid control and sealing solutions, providing products such as PFA/PTFE fittings, tubing, valves, and mechanical seals for semiconductor manufacturing. They focus on optimizing fluid control systems and manufacturing processes, supporting various advanced industries including semiconductors.
